The problem.

The problem.

The problem.

Apex Logistics occupied a new central distribution center with zero exterior visibility and an unbranded fleet of 35 commercial delivery vans. Drivers and logistics partners suffered continuous delays navigating between security gates, loading docks, and dispatch offices.

Without commanding highway-facing cabinet signage and clear architectural directional signs, visitors missed turn-offs, while the unbranded vans represented thousands of lost daily brand impressions on transit routes.

The results

100%

Fleet wrap consistency & color accuracy

70k+

Daily road impressions per wrapped van

Our turnkey solution delivered a 14ft illuminated double-sided exterior cabinet sign with Samsung IP68 LED illumination, paired with full 3M cast vinyl fleet wraps across all 35 vehicles and comprehensive station wayfinding.

The approach

We started where we always start — with structural site surveys and wind-load calculations. We engineered 3D CAD elevations and managed the municipal permit approval process from start to finish.

In our climate-controlled application bays, certified installers applied 3M IJ180mC-10 cast vinyl with matched gloss UV over-laminates. The exterior cabinet was constructed from heavy-gauge rustproof aluminum with internal welded steel reinforcement.
